sandbachFocus: Sandbach United delivered a dominant away performance at New Mills on Saturday 14 November, winning 7-1 in a comprehensive display. Despite New Mills taking an early lead through Adam Dahou's impressive 23rd-minute strike, Sandbach responded immediately and took control, with goals flowing freely in the second half to secure a commanding victory. This win extended their recent run of league success and maintains their position at the top of the table with 34 points from 16 games.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals maintained their extraordinary form with a 3-0 demolition of Stafford Town on Saturday, extending their unbeaten run to six consecutive league wins. Telford Town enjoyed a rare bright spot, securing their first win under new management with a 2-0 victory over Cheadle Heath Nomads. In an entertaining local derby, Allscott Heath edged out rivals Dawley Town 3-1 in a match that saw Dawley reduced to ten men late on after a red card. Bilston Town came from behind to beat Eccleshall 3-2 in a dramatic encounter with two goals conceded in the final five minutes. Market Drayton Town earned a narrow 1-0 victory at Foley Meir under their new management. Brereton Social returned to winning ways with a 2-1 success over Crewe. Shawbury United recovered from a goal down to beat AFC Bridgnorth 3-1 at home on Tuesday evening. The midweek fixture between New Mills and Crewe on Tuesday 17 November was postponed due to a waterlogged pitch.
